verse.verse_1: Verily, We have sent it down in the Night of Al-Qadr.
verse.verse_2: And what will make you know what the Night of Al-Qadr is
verse.verse_3: The Night of Al-Qadr is better than a thousand months.
verse.verse_4: Therein descend the angels and the Ruh by their Lord's permission with every matter.
verse.verse_5: There is peace until the appearance of dawn.
